2026-11-23ESDCFall Economic Statement Implementation Act, 2023Order Fixing December 13, 2026 as the Day on Which Division 12 of Part 5 of the Fall Economic Statement Implementation Act, 2023 Comes into ForceOrder Fixing December 13, 2026, as the day on which Division 12 of Part 5 of the Fall Economic Statement Implementation Act, 2023 comes into force in in order to amends the Employment Insurance Act and the Canada Labour Code (Code) which create a new 15-week benefit for adoptive parents, making the EI program more inclusive for Canadian families.N/A
subject: Order Fixing December 13, 2026 as the Day on Which Division 12 of Part 5 of the Fall Economic Statement Implementation Act, 2023 Comes into Force
precis: Order Fixing December 13, 2026, as the day on which Division 12 of Part 5 of the Fall Economic Statement Implementation Act, 2023 comes into force in in order to amends the Employment Insurance Act and the Canada Labour Code (Code) which create a new 15-week benefit for adoptive parents, making the EI program more inclusive for Canadian families.
